question:
The Petroleum reserves of India are in which of the following region?

I. Sedimentary basins of Assam.

II. Off-shore region in the Arabian sea
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Petroleum reserves in India** are primarily concentrated in the **sedimentary basins of Assam** and the **off-shore regions in the Arabian Sea**, making these two regions significant contributors to India's crude oil production.
 
• The **sedimentary basins of Assam** have long been known for their petroleum deposits. The **Dibrugarh and Tinsukia districts** host major oilfields such as Digboi, Bongaigaon, and Moran. *Hence, statement I is correct.*
 
• The **offshore region in the Arabian Sea** includes the **Bombay High**, India's largest offshore oilfield. It is managed by the **Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC)** and contributes significantly to India’s crude oil output. *Hence, statement II is correct.*
 
• India has a total of **26 sedimentary basins**, out of which **7 are currently producing oil**. These basins are divided into **onshore and offshore areas**.
 
• The petroleum reserves in these regions play a vital role in fulfilling the energy needs of the nation, reducing dependency on imports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Petroleum Reserves in Assam:**

 
 
• The **Digboi oilfield**, located in Assam, is the oldest oilfield in Asia and is still operational.
 
• Major oilfields in Assam include **Duliajan, Moran, Lakwa, and Baghjan**. These oilfields are managed by **Oil India Limited (OIL)**.
 
• The crude oil extracted from Assam is refined at the **Numaligarh Refinery**, which is one of the most modern refineries in India.
 
• Assam’s oilfields have been crucial for India’s petroleum industry since the late 19th century.
 
 
 
• **Offshore Reserves in the Arabian Sea:**
 
 
• **Bombay High**, discovered in **1974**, is India’s largest offshore oilfield and is located about **160 km off the Mumbai coast**.
 
• Other important offshore fields include **Neelam, Heera, and Bassein**, which also contribute significantly to India's crude oil production.
 
• The Arabian Sea reserves are managed by **ONGC**, which employs advanced technologies for exploration and production.
 
• Offshore production accounts for more than **40% of India's total crude oil output**.
 
 
 
• **India’s Sedimentary Basins:**
 
 
• India has **26 sedimentary basins**, categorized into **onshore and offshore regions**.
 
• Some of the notable onshore basins include **Assam-Arakan, Cambay, and Rajasthan**, while offshore basins include the **Krishna-Godavari Basin** and **Cauvery Basin**.
 
• Exploration and production activities are carried out by organizations such as **ONGC, Oil India Limited, and private sector companies**.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Petroleum Reserves:**
 
 
• Petroleum reserves are vital for meeting India's **energy demands**, which are increasing due to industrialization and urbanization.
 
• India imports approximately **80% of its crude oil**, and domestic reserves help reduce the import dependency.
 
• The petroleum sector significantly contributes to India's **GDP** and employment, especially in regions like Assam and Gujarat.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Bombay High:**

 
 
• Discovered in **1974**, it is located in the Arabian Sea.
 
• It contributes approximately **38% of India’s total crude oil production**.
 
• ONGC uses advanced technologies like **Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR)** to maximize output.
 
 
 
• **Assam Oilfields:**
 
 
• Assam’s oilfields have been operational since the late 19th century.
 
• The oil produced is refined at **Guwahati, Bongaigaon, and Numaligarh refineries**.
 
• These oilfields are known for their **high-quality crude oil**.
 
 
 
• **Krishna-Godavari Basin:**
 
 
• Located in Andhra Pradesh, it is one of the richest offshore reserves.
 
• It has significant deposits of **natural gas and crude oil**.
 
• Production from this basin contributes to India’s **energy security**.
